hard_failures.axis: canonical stage-2 acceptance rejects the frozen bytes / pinned acceptance evidence is stale (hash-bound)
hard_failures.finding: Running the declared stage-2 semantic auditor of the canonical two-stage acceptance pipeline on the frozen rev29 bytes returns verdict=reject with failed_rules=['R03'], detail="binder '(q,t0)' absent from formal sentence". Cause: quantifiers.ordered[5] uses binder '(q,t0)' while quantifiers.formal renders the same quantifier as 'not exists q in I+ and t0 in [0,T)', so R03's literal binder-in-formal containment check fails. Reproduction: structural stage passes (check_class_schema.py --json -> pass, failed_rules=[]), stage 2 rejects. The same R03 failure reproduces on the rev12 cce9 snapshot; the rev11 b65fcc0f snapshot passes R03. Meanwhile artifacts/formulation/evidence/acceptance_pipeline_report.json (pinned by FROZEN rev29 at sha256 9b7d6c8208d3beae2510c5c9c0a4bdaf7ede8adb277cd2a4f6f9cd0fd430f0c6, mtime 2026-09-12T00:27:40, i.e. before rev12 was written at 00:31:41) records canonical af_wcc_vacuum.yaml semantic='pass' and overall verdict PASS on the rev11-era bytes, and the report contains no input sha256 for any schema, so it cannot be re-bound to the frozen bytes. The schema therefore cannot cite a passing canonical acceptance at its own frozen hash.
hard_failures.falsifier: Re-run `python3 artifacts/worker-06/spec_conformance_audit.py artifacts/formulation/schemas/af_wcc_vacuum.yaml` against the d9ce bytes and obtain verdict=accept with failed_rules=[]; or emit a regenerated acceptance_pipeline_report.json that records the d9ce input sha256 and PASSES both stages; or obtain a controller/rule-spec adjudication that R03's literal binder rule is not binding for class schemas, with the pipeline tool updated accordingly.

findings.axis: undefined symbol in a non-operative formal field
findings.finding: quantifiers.negation_normal_form is written in terms of P_WCC(D). P_WCC occurs exactly once in the whole file (measured: occurrences=1) and has no definition leaf (measured: definition_leaf_found=false). The operative fields (quantifiers.formal, conclusion.statement_formal) are closed over defined symbols, so this is a definitional gap in a secondary field, not an open formula in the class predicate.

findings.axis: ordered[] data binder vs formal restriction (carried from F-071-05, escalated)
findings.finding: quantifiers.ordered binds (Sigma,h,K) to domain_id D2 (the whole data class), while quantifiers.formal and conclusion.statement_formal restrict the same rung to G_r subset D2 (comeager). A consumer reconstructing semantics from ordered[] alone reads the forbidden for-all-data strengthening. The ordered/formal pair is also what R03 consumes literally, so the representation now has a measured downstream cost (HF-071R3-01). Same convention in F2a/F2b.
